records.scope: Flask application implementing the cboe.com mirror: quotes, option chains, market statistics, insights, Options Institute, products, account flows. Route/URL patterns and page structure follow the upstream site.
Build-time conversion of the scraped upstream snapshot into the SQLite seed database. Idempotent seed functions; runtime DB is frozen from the snapshot, not live data.

Build-time only (gitignored): captured JSON/HTML from www.cboe.com and its public data APIs (delayed_quotes quotes/intraday/options/symbol_book endpoints, market statistics pages, Insights article pages, Options Institute pages, tradable product pages) plus the image download manifest. Source of the seed content.

Frozen mirror snapshot: 8 symbols with delayed quotes and 3,113 intraday bars, 83,136 real option contracts, 35,648-row symbol directory, 9 dates of daily market statistics, 319 Insights articles with bodies, 21 Options Institute experts, 3 upcoming classes, 4 product pages, static/about/hours/GTH pages, benchmark users.

Every HF-managed runtime image has a local byte count, SHA-256 and source URL in asset_inventory.json: 844 files downloaded directly from cdn.cboe.com (expert headshots, article charts, OI heroes/banners, associate profiles, meganav ads, footer patterns, quotes-page art). No placeholders, no generated images.

Inter, Open Sans and Montserrat woff2 subsets from Google Fonts (SIL OFL), Source Sans Pro woff2 from cboe.com's own font hosting (SIL OFL), plus the Cboe-hosted Noto/Hanken/Ubuntu Mono subsets referenced by the live stylesheet.
Social/link icons and favicon downloaded directly from cdn.cboe.com; the Cboe wordmark logo is reproduced inline in the templates from the live header markup.

Layout, color tokens (cboe navy/green/cyan scale), typography and component structure adapted from the live site's rendered pages and stylesheet variables. Frozen mirror copy, not a live representation of cboe.com.
30 contributor-defined benchmark tasks (web_name, id, ques, web, upstream_url only). No answers, no verifier keys; the reviewer adds the grading contract.
Mirror provenance, trademark attribution, and takedown contact.
